purpose: Read-only metadata capture for the omitted Vault helper. No secret values queried. Preserve the definition; change EXECUTE ACLs only in the separately approved cutover.

function.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aka_agent_get_vault_secret(p_name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'vault'
AS $function$
  SELECT decrypted_secret
  FROM vault.decrypted_secrets
  WHERE name = p_name
  LIMIT 1;
$function$
